faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR NEERI Project Scientist-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the CSIR NEERI Project Scientist-II recruitment is 03 September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Scientist-II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Scientist-II position in the CSIR NEERI recruitment 2026. This is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Scientist-II post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification is M.E./ M.Tech in Civil/ Environmental Engg/ Computer Science & Engineering/ Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering from a recognized university, along with 5 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Scientist-II position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Scientist-II post is 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Scientist-II role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Scientist-II position will receive a salary of Rs. 67,000/- per month plus HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the CSIR NEERI Project Scientist-II recruitment will be based on an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. In which mode should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications for the CSIR NEERI Project Scientist-II recruitment must be submitted in online mode only.

faq.question: Q9. Where is CSIR NEERI located?
faq.answer: CSIR National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (CSIR NEERI) is located in Nagpur, Maharashtra, with the pincode 440020.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job for the Project Scientist-II position is contractual in nature.
